title: All levels of a coherent formal module have the same support
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme (a locally Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth] with quasi-compact underlying space), $\mathcal I\subseteq\mathcal O_X$ a quasi-coherent sheaf of ideals and $(\mathcal F_n)_{n\ge1}$ an object of $\mathit{Coh}(X,\mathcal I)$ [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module]. Then $\operatorname{Supp}(\mathcal F_n)=\operatorname{Supp}(\mathcal F_1)$ for every $n\ge1$, where $\operatorname{Supp}(\mathcal F)=\{x\in X:\mathcal F_x\ne0\}$ [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base] (2).

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, proof of Lemma 0CYV (lemma-systems-with-proper-support), first sentence of the proof of (1) ('Then Supp(F_n) = Supp(F_1) for all n >= 1'), stated there without proof

mathlib_searches.query: support of sheaf of modules in inverse system of coherent modules modulo powers of ideal is constant
mathlib_searches.results: Module.support, Module.stableUnderSpecialization_support (RingTheory), IdealSheafData.isClosed_supportSet, IdealSheafData.support: support of a module over a ring and of an ideal sheaf only

mathlib_searches.query: inverse system of modules F_n with I^n F_n = 0 and F_{n+1}/I^n F_{n+1} = F_n has support of F_n equal to support of F_1
mathlib_searches.results: Module.support_quotient (Supp(M/IM) = Supp M cap V(I), RingTheory.Support), Hausdorffification, AdicCompletion.submodule, localCohomology: ring-level only; Module.support_quotient with I nilpotent on M would give the module-level analogue but there is no sheaf-level statement
no support of a sheaf of O_X-modules in AlgebraicGeometry; no inverse systems of sheaves of modules

lead_note: The proof sketch that the worker had put in the statement was moved here by L (2026-10-10): Idea: the transition map $\mathcal F_n\to\mathcal F_1$ is surjective, giving $\supseteq$; on stalks $\mathcal F_{1,x}\cong\mathcal F_{n,x}/\mathcal I_x\mathcal F_{n,x}$ and $\mathcal I_x^n\mathcal F_{n,x}=0$, so $\mathcal F_{1,x}=0$ forces $\mathcal F_{n,x}=\mathcal I_x^n\mathcal F_{n,x}=0$.)
